name: Optical Sales by Item
query:
SELECT
 oi.item_role AS "Role::110",
 oi.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item:150",
 oi.item_name AS "Item Name::200",
 SUM(oi.qty) AS "Quantity:Float:90",
 SUM(oi.amount) AS "Amount:Currency:120"
FROM `tabOptical Order Item` oi
INNER JOIN `tabOptical Order` o ON o.name = oi.parent AND oi.parenttype = 'Optical Order'
WHERE o.status NOT IN ('Draft', 'Cancelled')
GROUP BY oi.item_role, oi.item_code, oi.item_name
ORDER BY SUM(oi.amount) DESC
